messages:
Noor: dropped a compact scorecard mock for discussion. goal: reduce row height but keep critical helper text for filter semantics. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-scorecard :sparkles: Jin: nice work. main concern: compact rows may hide the "Tags = any" helper which causes support confusion. can we keep a tiny persistent hint? Priya: accessibility: even small hints must be keyboard-focusable and readable by SR. propose an info button with aria-describedby that opens a short tooltip: "Tags: match any; filters across categories combine with AND." Marco: microcopy nit: use "Match any by default" vs just "any" 1 to avoid ambiguity. Also consider a toggle for advanced users to switch to "Match all" mode. Noor: design tradeoffs: 1) keep inline hint in compact (smaller font) 2) hide hint behind info icon 3) surface toggle in a collapsed menu. which do we prefer? Jin: prefer option 2: info icon keeps rows tight and provides a clear, discoverable affordance. ensure icon has 44x44 touch area on mobile. Priya: aria example for the info button: ```
Tags: match any by default. Use the toggle to change to match all.
``` Also ensure SR reads the tooltip when focused. Marco: UX flow: add a small persistent text in the toolbar that mirrors tooltip for quick scanning: "Tags: match any" (visually low-contrast). that solves support spikes. Noor: ok plan: info icon + toolbar mini-hint in compact. Priya will write a11y acceptance criteria, Marco will propose microcopy variants, Jin will validate touch target + responsive layout. I'll update figma and aim to ship to staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:
